title: Ce-doped nano-Fe–TiO2 composites for photocatalytic degradation of naphthol blue black in aqueous medium
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,25322-25336
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02583D, Paper

In this study, the effectiveness of Ce-doped nano-Fe–TiO2 composites as photocatalysts for the degradation of Naphthol Blue Black (NBB) dye present in water was investigated.
